15979-miss-caprice.title: Miss Caprice
15979-miss-caprice.creator: Unknown
15979-miss-caprice.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. As to the ladies of Malta, their costume is very odd, and reminds one somewhat of Spain. In part, it consists of a black silk petticoat, bound round the waist, over a body of some other kind of silk or print which is called the _half onuella_. The upper part, the _onuella_, of the same material, is drawn into neat gathers for the length of a foot about the center of one of the outer seams.

arxiv-2103-15378.title: Bilayer graphene encapsulated within monolayers of WS 2 or Cr 2 Ge 2 Te 6 : Tunable proximity spin-orbit or exchange coupling
arxiv-2103-15378.creator: Klaus Zollner, Jaroslav Fabian
arxiv-2103-15378.description: Abstract Van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures consisting of bilayer graphene (BLG) encapsulated within monolayers of strong spin-orbit semiconductor WS 2 or ferromagnetic semiconductor Cr 2 Ge 2 Te 6 (CGT), are investigated. By performing realistic first-principles calculations we capture the essential BLG band structure features, including layer- and sublattice-resolved proximity spin-orbit or exchange couplings.

arxiv-2212-13531.title: Physics informed neural networks for elliptic equations with oscillatory differential operators
arxiv-2212-13531.creator: Arnav Gangal agangal00@gmail.com, Luis Kim luisyookim02@gmail.com, Sean P. Carney spcarney@math.ucla.edu
arxiv-2212-13531.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Arnav Gangal agangal00@gmail.com, Luis Kim luisyookim02@gmail.com, Sean P. Carney spcarney@math.ucla.edu. Physics informed neural network (PINN) based solution methods for differential equations have recently shown success in a variety of scientific computing applications. Several authors have reported difficulties, however, when using PINNs to solve equations with multiscale features. The objective of the present work is to illustrate and explain the difficulty of using standard PINNs for the particular case of divergence-form elliptic partial differential equations (PDEs) with oscillatory coefficients present in the differential operator.

arxiv-2310-06062.title: Detecting Iron Oxidation States in Liquids with the VOXES Bragg Spectrometer
arxiv-2310-06062.creator: Simone Manti 1, Marco Miliucci 1 † \dagger, Alessandro Scordo 1*, Roberto Bedogni 1, Alberto Clozza 1, Mihail Iliescu 1, Gabriel Moskal 2, Kristian Piscicchia 1,3, Alessio Porcelli 3, Diana Sirghi 1,3,4, Florin Sirghi 1, Catalina Curceanu 1
arxiv-2310-06062.description: Abstract Determining the oxidation states of metals assumes great importance in various applications because a variation in the oxidation number can drastically influence the material properties. As an example, this becomes evident in edible liquids like wine and oil, where a change in the oxidation states of the contained metals can significantly modify both the overall quality and taste.

arxiv-2402-00985.title: Upper Limits on the Cosmic Neutrino Background from Cosmic Rays
arxiv-2402-00985.creator: Mar Císcar-Monsalvatje 1 , Gonzalo Herrera 2,1,3 , Ian M. Shoemaker 2
arxiv-2402-00985.description: Abstract Extragalactic and galactic cosmic rays scatter with the cosmic neutrino background during propagation to Earth, yielding a flux of relic neutrinos boosted to larger energies. If an overdensity of relic neutrinos is present in galaxies, and neutrinos are massive enough, this flux might be detectable by high-energy neutrino experiments. For a lightest neutrino of mass m ν ∼ 0.

arxiv-2407-03318.title: Constant-Factor EFX Exists for Chores Thanks: Work supported by NSF Grants CCF-1942321 and CCF-2334461.
arxiv-2407-03318.creator: Jugal Garg, Aniket Murhekar, John Qin
arxiv-2407-03318.description: Abstract We study the problem of fair allocation of chores among agents with additive preferences. In the discrete setting, envy-freeness up to any chore (EFX) has emerged as a compelling fairness criterion. However, establishing its (non-)existence or achieving a meaningful approximation remains a major open question in fair division.

arxiv-2509-15839.title: Multi-Physics: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Multimodal LLMs Reasoning on Chinese Multi-subject Physics Problems
arxiv-2509-15839.creator: Zhongze Luo, Zhenshuai Yin, Yongxin Guo, Zhichao Wang, Jionghao Zhu, Xiaoying Tang
arxiv-2509-15839.description: Abstract While multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) demonstrate remarkable reasoning progress, their application in specialized scientific domains like physics reveals significant gaps in current evaluation benchmarks. Specifically, existing benchmarks often lack fine-grained subject coverage, neglect the step-by-step reasoning process, and are predominantly English-centric, failing to systematically evaluate the role of visual information.

arxiv-2601-15483.title: Data complexity signature predicts quantum projected learning benefit for antibiotic resistance
arxiv-2601-15483.creator: Kahn Rhrissorrakrai, Filippo Utro, Alex Milinovich, Sandip Vasavada, Daniel Rhoads, Laxmi Parida, Glenn T. Werneburg
arxiv-2601-15483.description: Abstract Abstract This study presents the first large-scale empirical evaluation of quantum machine learning for predicting antibiotic resistance in clinical urine cultures. Antibiotic resistance is amongst the top threats to humanity, and inappropriate antibiotic use is a main driver of resistance.

arxiv-2602-22932.creator: Wenhui Tan, Xiaoyi Yu, Jiaze Li, Yijing Chen, Jianzhong Ju, Zhenbo Luo, Ruihua Song, Jian Luan
arxiv-2602-22932.description: Abstract Efficiently understanding long-form videos remains a fundamental challenge for multimodal large language models (MLLMs). pmc-11341276.title: Establishing large mammal population trends from heterogeneous count data
pmc-11341276.creator: R. Pradel, P.‐C. Renaud, O. Pays, P. Scholte, J. O. Ogutu, F. Hibert, N. Casajus, F. Mialhe, H. Fritz
pmc-11341276.description: Monitoring population trends is pivotal to effective wildlife conservation and management. However, wildlife managers often face many challenges when analyzing time series of census data due to heterogeneities in sampling methodology, strategy, or frequency. We present a three‐step method for modeling trends from time series of count data obtained through multiple census methods (aerial or ground census and expert estimates).

pmc-11356698.title: The Impact of Titanium Hydroxyapatite Doping on the Mechanical and Biological Properties of Photocured Resin
pmc-11356698.creator: Xiaopan Li, Chao Yao, Junfu Shen, Siqi Zhu, Yiyun Kong, Chun Yao, Yuankai Zhou, Jing Xia, Mehmet Remzi Dokmeci, Liqun Ning
pmc-11356698.description: Photocured resin materials are widely used in various fields, such as 3D printing, medical applications, and dentistry. However, the strength, wear resistance, and antibacterial properties of photocured resin are relatively limited, rendering it susceptible to potential failures. In this recent study, photocured composite resins incorporating titanium-doped hydroxyapatite (Ti-HAp) were fabricated to investigate their mechanical and biological properties.

pmc-11525795.creator: Kristína Plevová, Véronique Michelet, Sylvain Antoniotti
pmc-11525795.description: With peculiar structural features at the surface of small metal nanoparticles, some discrete sites can display catalytic behaviour similar to what could be observed with mononuclear metal catalysts in solution.
